column1: # igver e2e cases (docs/plans/20260925_audit_bugfix_plan.md §4.2). Read by test/e2e/e2e_runner.py.
# args: shlex-split; the harness appends `-o {OUT}` and the mode's container flags. cwd = test/e2e/fixtures.
# Placeholders: {BAM} test/test_tumor.bam (hg19, no chr), {FIX} fixtures dir, {OUT} case output dir,
# expect_files: ';'-separated exact `ls -A` of {OUT} (a kept <uuid>.batch is reported but not compared); '-' = empty.
# checks (';'-separated): grep:RE / nogrep:RE on stdout+stderr; count:RE=N; width:N (every PNG);
#   tmp_clean (no igver_* dir left in the case TMPDIR); pdf_width:N (every PDF > 20 KB, rasterises at 300 dpi = igver's default --dpi to N px); home_untouched (real ~/igv log mtime + prefs sha1);
#   rundirs:N (distinct igver_igv_ dirs named in the output); same_as:CASE / differs_from:CASE (pixel compare
#   of the same-named PNG); overlay:poisoned (bind a copy of fixtures/poisoned_igv over ~/igv);
#   setup:stale_index (copy {BAM}+index to {SETUP}, index older than BAM); visual (PNG must be opened by hand).
